message.content: {"B_expression":"-1/(2*(1+sqrt(1+r))**2)","C_expression":"-1/2","derivation":"Retained unchanged from P03_W0. The construction operates on the two-slot covariance quotient E=(2g+g^2-r)+2ug with g=r/2+chi_r(r)*chi_u(u)*(r^2*B+u*r*C). B=-1/(2*(1+sqrt(1+r))^2) is the Proposition 7.6 source-only pure-remainder canceler: at u=0, g=r/2+r^2*B=sqrt(1+r)-1 exactly, zeroing the pure part. C=-1/2 cancels the leading cross-term ur to first order, since 2*u*(u*r*C)=-u^2*r and 2*u*(r/2)=ur, so the ur contribution to E is eliminated at leading order, leaving residual O(r^3+ur^2+u^2r). The certificate confirms ANALYTIC_ON_CORE_NEIGHBORHOOD for both bodies: B is analytic for 1+r>0 (covering r in [-1/2,1/2] where 1+r>=1/2) and C is a constant. Numerical feedback confirms: UNIFORM rows (|r|~2e-4, |u|~8e-3) show residuals ~1e-8; LEFT rows inside the chi support show residuals ~1e-7 to 1e-9; LEFT x=1/8 s=0 (u=-0.5, outside rectangle) correctly receives only g=r/2 with no B,C contribution; ZERO rows are exactly unchanged. Weighted column residuals are at 1e-20 to 1e-72 scale. No revision is indicated by the data.","inspect":[],"note":"Program retained for P03_W1. Successor checks: (1) at the next target stage (smaller tau), verify that the UNIFORM and small-u LEFT/RIGHT rows maintain residual at or below the O(r^3+u^2*r) scale observed here (~1e-8); (2) the LEFT x=1/8 s=0 row (u=-0.5) and RIGHT x=63/64 s=1 row (u=-3.0) are far outside the rectangle and will always show large residuals under the linear reference r/2 -- this is correct behavior, not a program failure; (3) the chi_u transition zone (1/8<|u|<1/4) gives partial correction; residuals there (e.g. LEFT x=1/4 s=0, residual ~2.8e-6) are expected and do not indicate a smoothness defect; (4) the certificate remains CONDITIONAL_SMOOTH_FAMILY / ANALYTIC_ON_CORE_NEIGHBORHOOD -- sufficient for the coefficient family, not a full PDE certificate; (5) the state variable u is not reset between stages; each stage reads the actual stored z_before and computes r=p-z^2, u=z-1 independently."}
